notes.title: All my games now available for Autumn Sales - New TDS Release soon!
notes.content:
Greetings guys!

As you might have seen, General Practitioner, Yomi Alliance and The Coroner Saga are available at a discounted price for Steam's Autumn Sales! The same discount applies on Itch-io as well!

Today I'm announcing you that the next chapter for "The Devil's Shoes - An erotic Visual Novel", will be available on Sunday, November 29th for 5$+ patrons and as an itch-io limited exclusive (until it reaches chapter 6.

[list]
[*] Play "The Massage", "Working Friend" and "The Guest", three erotic stories, each 10k words long
[*] "The Massage" features 18 (eighteen) different endings to unlock
[*] "Working Friend" features 10 (ten) different endings to unlock
[*] "The Guest" features 5 (five) different endings to unlock
[*] 5-6 hours of gameplay to unlock every ending
[*] More stories are going to be added in the coming weeks
[*] Customize your name and the name of your love interest
[*] "The Massage" and "Working Friend" feature a [b]M/F relationship[/b], "The Guest" features a [b]M/M relationship[/b] other stories will feature F/F,  M/F/F and Solo
[/list]

Grab the game now while it only costs you 2 chapters, as the price will change once Chapter 3 is released! https://bruni-multimedia.itch.io/the-devils-shoes

Some of you asked me if single chapters would be available stand-alone, however this is not the case for this game. Unlike "The Coroner Saga", The Devil's Shoes was not intended to be released episodically, but as a single-standalone game without any DLC. The price of the game will change as each chapter is released, so you can save some money by buying it sooner than later, or by pledging at least 5$ on [url=https://patreon.com/brunimultimedia][b]my Patreon Page[/b][/url], which also supports my work!

Thank you guys, you're one of the most amazing communities I might have hoped for when I started this job!

notes.title: Patreon Page Overhauled with new Exclusive rewards!
notes.content:
Did you know we have a Patreon page?

[b]Back in 2017 everything started there[/b]: General Practitioner was just an idea, a bold project for an expert software developer who still had no experience in videogame developer until then.
Patreon is where I put myself to the challenge of developing something worth playing, funny and interesting with a bit of educational purpose and a spicy sexy story to deal with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/b0f69b3fa3840f867aaa47e40e9cd99be7cf1254.png[/img]

Today I want to introduce you my updated, fully overhauled, Patreon page [url=https://patreon.com/brunimultimedia]https://patreon.com/brunimultimedia[/url]

Many of you will surely ask why they should give me more money after they already paid for the full game on digital delivery platforms. That's a proper question, and I'm going to tell you that [b]no in-game content will be cut from the Steam release to be available on Patreon only[/b].

[b]I worked a lot to find rewards you won't find anywhere else[/b], and I promise you that you won't find in-game content in such rewards. Still, crowdfunding is the only way true indie developers can survive and keep doing what they do: creating new game experience for you to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/130a8fc552948d24cd2723475c7c32abb21a408c.png[/img]

[b]If you join our Patreon page you will receive many rewards![/b]

[list]
[*] Have you ever considered [b]becoming a Visual Novel developer[/b]? Follow my lessons to start working in Ren'Py as I do
[*] [b]Exclusive interviews[/b] with actors and artists who work with me, including Star Trek actor Manu Intiraymi and many more...
[*] [b]Choose which path the story will take [/b]by replying to our monthly polls!
[*] [b]Request a scene[/b]. You can write any scene you'd like to include in our games and play it once it becomes available!
[*] [b]Receive exclusive items such as mugs, stickers, posters and t-shirts[/b] for our most loyal followers
[*] [b]Grab collectors copies[/b] of my games as soon as they become available!
[*] Learn the [b]Tricks of the Trade[/b] of a videogame developer!
[*] [b]Exclusive content preview[/b]: read the stories and play the game ahead of others!
[*] [b]...many more[/b] are available on the Patreon page and more are going to be announced soon!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/048629bf3584da3b39c68e7c4826c8798b7b98d1.png[/img]

If you like what I do, if you wish to support my work and receive very special rewards, [url=https://patreon.com/brunimultimedia]visit my Patreon page[/url]!

Join Yomi Alliance, be a hero!

notes.title: Where are we going next... to the stars, to hell and beyond!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow doctors!

As General Practitioner is approaching its Beta and Final Release due in December, we started planning our game development future for the foreseeable future, and we're excited to announce you a few projects we have in store, the first of which will be Alpha-Ready when GP will be finalized.

2020 will be full of projects I'm very excited about:
- [b]Yomi Alliance[/b]: a sci-fi Adult RPG/Visual Novel (see next)
- [b]The Coroner Saga[/b]: Episodes 3, 4 and 5
- New DLCs and updates for [b]General Practitioner[/b], many of which for free
- [b]The Devil's Shoes[/b], a brand new 8 hours long erotic videogame
- [b]The Interview[/b], a General Practitioner erotic spinoff 6 hours long

While some of our projects will be announced on a later date, today I want you to know about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160950/Yomi_Alliance/]Yomi Alliance[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/3ad34076fd6ba1914394280c653e65623c82da37.png[/img]

This project is ambitious, even bigger than General Practitioner. You can see informations about it on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160950/Yomi_Alliance/][b]Steam Page[/b][/url] and the [url=www.yomialliance.space][b]Official Website[/b][/url]

Featuring dozens of hours of gameplay, you will experience a different game every time you run a playthrough, since every career choice and even your starting species will determine different outcomes in conversations, actual gameplay and situations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/22a3387c3f308b85275762cac3150aecb5111e3b.png[/img]

A project this big will need some time to be completed of course, and a lot of money as well. That's why we're starting the Alpha Early Access in December and we're also launching a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/brunimultimedia/yomi-alliance-an-epic-sci-fi-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url] for the project on October 31st!

Supporting us on Kickstarter and/or [url=www.patreon.com/generalpractitioner]Patreon[/url] ensures us to keep doing our job: creating different kinds of Visual Novels and make you enjoy them for many hours for the months to come!
All Patreon rewards have been changed to reflect the new releases, so you can take a look to them as well, even though of course the Kickstarter crowdfunding is the best way to show us your support (and earn a Free Steam Key as well).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/9b69f7573ec3a7540fc5593b14d60d62bcc1679d.png[/img]

[b]You can apply for the Kickstarter from October 31st to November 30th, 2019[/b].

[b]A DEMO of the game will be available on October 31st[/b] on Steam as well. The demo will feature the first fours Academy Weeks and one of the first Away Missions. You can choose any of the four species and three genders in the demo and a career of your choice between Command and Science.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33586573/df3ee1c2263dbad748471bcf282a4ce327b282ff.png[/img]

Alpha release in December will feature a FULL Academy training section (about 20+ hours of gameplay) and every month we'll release further content with priority release for our crowdfunders.

We're very excited about this opportunity, we hope you'll keep following us, supporting us and always be safe and healthy!

Thank you.

notes.title: Announcing "The Coroner Saga - An Otome episodic Visual Novel" and more...
notes.content:
Greetings guys!

As promised today I want to share some big news with you: the upcoming release of a new Bruni Multimedia project - [b]The Coroner Saga[/b]. This is a separate project from General Practitioner, a different team of few but very dedicated people are actually working on it so this isn't going to change the scheduled release of General Practitioner in any way (by the way, you can take a look at the game's roadmap here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/936960/announcements/detail/1701693602812076371

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/fdf7837015cd518b8b5c3cd9a4754d960089f086.jpg[/img]

[b]What is The Coroner Saga (TCS)?[/b] It's an otome Visual Novel, a smaller project compared to General Practitioner and an episodic-release one as well. Each "Season" of TCS will be made of 6 episodes, each varying in gameplay lenght of about 5-6 hours and with many different romance options and endings.

It is also a very interesting and well written story, having award-winner author JD Glass as Lead Writer for the project (someone might recognize her from her work on Voltage Entertainment's Visual Novels as well as many other works).

The Visual Novel will also be available on Japanese with fully-translated interface and game. Other translations will be available if there's enough interest in the project as well. As for General Practitioner, a Patreon crowdfunding is also established for TCS with specific rewards for pledgers, and if a certain goal is met translations will be implemented for TCS.

The Coroner Saga features:

[list]
[*] An original Otome Visual Novel written by award winner JD Glass
[*] Adult gameplay with realistic sexual situations and medical-related nudity
[*] Full HD graphics (1920x1080)
[*] 6 six-hour-long episodes for Season 1
[*] Different choices and routes will bring you to different outcome in the story, changing not only the single episode but the whole season's experience.
[*] Real medical content and scenarios written in collaboration with a real medical doctor who already worked to our Early Access Visual Novel General Practitioner
[*] 6 different murder cases to solve. Each case will have you work in a simulation-minigame to find the correct clues.
[*] Choose your gameplay: Vanilla for the game without adult content or “Story” for the complete experience
[*] Original 10-tracks Soundtrack
[*] Stunning user interface developed by Graphic Designer Laura "Sasquatchii" Henderson
[*] Full Japanese Translation
[*] Available for PC, MAC, Linux (Android Devices in Q4 2019 as well)
[/list]

There's a news about our website as well: take a look to discover what has changed and explore the two new websites we made to keep each project separated:

[list]
[*] New Bruni Multimedia Website ([url=www.brunimultimedia.com]www.brunimultimedia.com[/url])
[*] General Practitioner dedicated website ([url=www.generalpractitionergame.com]www.generalpractitionergame.com[/url])
[*] The Coroner Saga dedicated website ([url=www.thecoronersaga.com]www.thecoronersaga.com[/url])
[/list]

The game is already on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010260/The_Coroner_Saga/]Steam Store page[/url]: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010260/The_Coroner_Saga/

It won't be released as an Early Access game, it will be a full release right from the beginning. Release date is set for April but more informations will be released in the upcoming weeks.

If you wish to start supporting the project and you liked our work on General Practitioner [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010260/The_Coroner_Saga/]add The Coroner Saga to your wishlist[/url]!

Thank you for following us and our projects, we are very proud of our small but dedicated fan community and we wish you to always be safe and healthy!

PS: exciting news for General Practitioner are coming as well in a few hours: stay tuned!
